compared.difference: The only public item of this article counts the three-part infinite arithmetic-progression theorem: extendable difference sets are embedded into octant hypergraphs and one part is proved infinite. It is about difference sets and octants in R^3, not about strips, shallow hitting sets or the parameter m_{A*}(k), and no step of it is used here.

The prepared strip target is a non-existence theorem for 2-shallow hitting sets in the m-uniform members of the primal strip family A, proved by an eleven-cluster gadget with two figures. This target is a strict lower bound for the polychromatic parameter of the dual family A-star and is proved by a four-family pigeonhole on missing colours; neither statement implies the other.

The bottomless-rectangle target refutes 3-shallow hitting sets for a different range family B by an A/B/C gadget with a two-case split; it shares neither the family, the parameter nor the construction with this item.
